summary: Captures the rationale for the changes made in RFC 8714. It gives background on past IETF Trust arrangements, in which IAOC members served as trustees, and why the move to IASA 2.0 required a new approach to selecting trustees.

eli5.summary: This is the reasons note for a rule change about who looks after the IETF's property, explaining why the old setup had to go.
